summary.text: Levi Dean is a Republican state representative from Xenia who has represented Ohio House District 71 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as small business owner and notes that he served on the Xenia City Council.

paragraphs.text: Dean won the March 19, 2024 Republican primary for District 71, defeating Joshua Day, Robert Fudge and Tyler Scott, and won the general election on November 5, 2024 against Democrat Krista Magaw.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments for the 2025-2026 session as Commerce and Labor, Development, Agriculture, and Small Business, where he is vice chair.
Dean advanced from the 2026 Republican primary with 100 percent of the vote, and Krista Magaw is the Democratic candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
